# openobserve_resources (Data Source)

Lists the resource types that can be named in an `openobserve_role` permission, for example `stream`, `dashboard`, or `alert`. Requires OpenObserve Enterprise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The resource types that can be named in an openobserve_role permission.
data "openobserve_resources" "available" {}

output "grantable_objects" {
  value = {
    for r in data.openobserve_resources.available.resources :
    r.key => r.display_name if r.visible
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `resources` (Attributes List) The resource types available for permission grants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `has_entities` (Boolean) Whether permissions can target individual entities, not just the whole type.
- `key` (String) Identifier used in a permission's `object`, for example `stream`.
- `parent` (String) Parent resource type for hierarchical inheritance.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the type appears in the permissions UI.
